title: ITVX / App icon among competitors
slide_intent: Test whether a reduced symbol and colour field identify the service in an app grid, because viewers need to recognize the same service across different situations.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen continuity between campaign recognition and service use.
demonstration: A close crop of a phone shows the yellow ITVX app tile with a dark X beside a Netflix tile.
practical_value: Test whether a reduced symbol and colour field identify the service in an app grid.

content_islands.name: App grid
content_islands.spec: The ITVX tile is visible alongside other streaming apps.

content_islands.name: Identifier
content_islands.spec: A dark X fills the yellow rounded-square tile.

reference_purposes.Expression: A close crop of a phone shows the yellow ITVX app tile with a dark X beside a Netflix tile.
reference_purposes.Application: Test whether a reduced symbol and colour field identify the service in an app grid. Evidence is the shown application, not a mandatory layout rule.
